title: Natalie Massenet and Erik Torstensson: A fiery romance torn apart by a courtroom battle
subhead: 'Sewn and torn' (4/5). Love stories and friendships can sometimes end badly, even in the world of fashion. For 16 years, the romance between the founder of luxury e-shop Net-a-Porter and the Swedish golden boy blossomed alongside their financial empire. But in 2025, when Natalie Massenet accused her partner of infidelity and fraud, their glamorous affair turned sordid.

The #MeToo wave shook up society and patients' expectations have evolved, reshaping boundaries between genders. Le Monde spent weeks behind closed doors in a private breast surgery practice.
